name: greenroom
description: A local, no-code app for running Playwright end-to-end checks against your live web app and reviewing the results.

scripts.deps:refresh: for p in pantry; do bun add @tjakoen/$p@github:tjakoen/$p#$(git ls-remote https://github.com/tjakoen/$p.git main | cut -c1-7); done && bun update @tjakoen/batch @tjakoen/grain @tjakoen/mill @tjakoen/proof

//dependencies: USE `bun install`, NOT npm — VERIFIED 2026-07-30 on a fresh clone with a cold cache. (1) `npm install` FAILS: @tjakoen/pantry (devDep) pins tjakoen.github.io#afc640a, a commit no longer on that remote; npm resolves the whole graph and runs `git checkout afc640a`, aborting the install even with --omit=dev, so the runtime deps never land. Bun fetches the same commit as a codeload tarball and succeeds — including pantry. The real fix is re-pinning that dep IN THE pantry REPO (`bun run deps:refresh` there, commit, then re-pin here); until then npm is unusable and bun depends on GitHub still serving an unreferenced commit. (2) A TOKEN IS REQUIRED: grain · mill · proof · batch are published to GitHub Packages (@tjakoen scope → see .npmrc), NOT to npmjs (404 there). Without a read:packages token in ~/.npmrc, install dies `401 … failed to resolve`. Do not 'fix' this by deleting .npmrc — that drops the scope mapping and sends the scope to npmjs, which only appears to work on a machine whose own ~/.npmrc still maps it. (3) EXACT PINS, no carets: bun.lock is gitignored (a lock over the nested git graph above goes stale and can't be regenerated), so exact versions are the only thing keeping a fresh clone identical to a verified one — a caret on grain silently floated 0.1.8 -> 0.1.12 between machines. Bump deliberately via `bun run deps:refresh`, then re-verify. Published grain 0.1.12 carries organisms/code-editor, so the editor chrome no longer needs vendoring. PLATFORM DEPS, each justified in plans/platform.md §8: better-auth + @better-auth/sso (accounts/SSO/teams), drizzle-orm over embedded bun:sqlite, monaco-editor (in-browser editor, self-hosted byte-served from node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs). drizzle-kit is a devDependency (migrations).
